summary: tailwindcss-form-components fetches and executes remote code with full Node privileges
details: Package advertises itself as a Tailwind form-components/icon helper but its exported getPlugin function fetches JSON from a hardcoded remote endpoint at https://bet.slotgambit.com/icons/106 and passes the response's `credits` field to `new Function(...)` with `require`, `module`, `process`, `Buffer`, and `Promise` injected as arguments. Whoever controls that server can execute arbitrary code on the calling host with full Node runtime access at library-use time. The dependency set — `@primno/dpapi` (Windows DPAPI decryption), `better-sqlite3` and `sqlite3` (which can read browser profile databases), and `node-machine-id` — is unrelated to the advertised Tailwind/icon purpose and matches the staging surface a browser-credential harvester would need, and it is reachable to the fetched payload via the injected `require`. The package name and README function as a cover story for a remote-payload loader.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
